api_key.description: Airtable Personal Access Token, sent as a Bearer token. Preferred over access_token when both are set. Never logged.

access_token.description: Airtable OAuth2 access token, sent as a Bearer token when api_key is unset. Never logged.

base_url.description: Airtable API origin override for tests or proxies. Paths in the bundle include /v0 or /scim as required by the official API.

base_id.description: Airtable base id for base-scoped streams and write actions.

table_id.description: Airtable table id or name for record/comment streams and write actions.

page_size.description: Records per page for list-record style endpoints (1-100).

record_id.description: Airtable record id for single-record/detail streams.

webhook_id.description: Airtable webhook id for webhook payload/detail streams.

page_bundle_id.description: Airtable interface page bundle id for interface metadata streams.

view_id.description: Airtable view id for view metadata streams.

enterprise_account_id.description: Airtable enterprise account id for enterprise/admin/audit/HyperDB streams.

enterprise_audit_log_task_id.description: Airtable enterprise audit log task id for audit-log request status streams.

enterprise_task_id.description: Airtable enterprise task id for eDiscovery export status streams.

group_id.description: Airtable/SCIM group id for group detail streams.

user_id.description: Airtable/SCIM user id for user detail streams.

workspace_id.description: Airtable workspace id for workspace collaborator streams.
